reasons.text: Both parts are buy molded parts with the same size, material and unit of measure, and their weights differ by only about 2%, so they describe the same cable gland.
Both parts are used in the same number of assemblies and are both Released, so the tie is broken by age, and 100-005622 is the older record.
The export classifications conflict, so the correct classification must be settled before the records are merged.
